title: Create an exploded desk lamp view
goal: Create an original six-part desk lamp scene with separated named components, save the editable Blender project, and render a labeled product view.

permissions.filesystem: Write only to the designated output directory. Do not overwrite existing files without approval.

steps.action: Choose an empty user-designated output directory and confirm both target filenames are unused.
steps.verify: The directory is writable and both output paths are clear.
steps.recovery: If either target exists, stop and ask before choosing another directory or replacing anything.

steps.action: Run the indexed Blender script in background mode with the approved output directory.
steps.verify: Blender exits successfully and writes the editable project and render.
steps.recovery: Preserve Blender's error output and rerun only after correcting the issue and confirming paths remain clear.

steps.action: Reopen the project and inspect its named meshes, labels, camera, lighting, and rendered image.
steps.verify: Six named parts remain separate, labels are readable, all parts are in frame, and both outputs are non-empty.
steps.recovery: Adjust spacing or camera framing in a copy and write to a new approved directory.
